title: Oracle host simulation away from queries
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, and let $C$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine with $C.k>0$. Choose states $en,ex$ of $C$, a language $O$ of Boolean strings, an input string $x$, and a configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$. For either Boolean tag $side$, suppose the query-tape head position of $c$ is nonnegative when $side$ is true and nonpositive when $side$ is false. If the run of $M$ with the empty oracle is not in its query state at any time $s<t$, then there is a Boolean tag $side'$ such that, after $t$ steps with oracle $O$, the query-tape head position is nonnegative when $side'$ is true and nonpositive when $side'$ is false, and the host machine’s run from the stable configuration encoding $c$ and $side$ equals the stable configuration encoding the configuration reached by $M$ with oracle $O$ and tag $side'$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Boolean oracle Turing machine
$C$ is a finite-state Boolean Turing machine
$C$ has at least one work tape
$O$ is a language of Boolean strings
The initial query-tape head position is nonnegative if $side$ is true and nonpositive if $side$ is false
The empty-oracle run is not in the query state at every time $s<t$
